players.product: 8-inch GaN-on-Si power devices for 800V HVDC and 48V server power

quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 results: revenue RMB1,213.3 million, up 46.4% from RMB828.5 million, which the company attributes to application breakthroughs in multiple fields with continuously increasing orders; gross profit RMB88.8 million vs a gross loss of RMB161.4 million, gross margin 7.3% vs -19.5% (scale effects, a shift to higher value-added products and cost control); loss for the year RMB840.5 million (-19.6%); adjusted EBITDA RMB52 million vs -RMB148 million; adjusted net loss (non-HKFRS) RMB676,351 thousand; R&D costs RMB374.2 million (+15.9%). By product: GaN discrete devices and GaN ICs RMB510.1 million (+41.3%); GaN wafers RMB253.4 million (-9.7%, part of wafer orders converted into discrete device and IC orders); GaN modules RMB446.2 million (+142.6%, on new-generation modules). Revenue by region: Chinese Mainland RMB1,096,411 thousand, overseas RMB116,862 thousand. Year-end cash and cash equivalents RMB879.0 million plus RMB1,636,738 thousand in bank certificates of deposit; net operating cash outflow RMB806.4 million.
quarterly_data.figure: Revenue RMB1,213.3 million (+46.4%); gross margin 7.3%; adjusted EBITDA RMB52 million

quarterly_data.signal: AI data centers (FY2025 annual report): revenue from GaN chips in AI and data center fields RMB63.19 million, up 50.20%. The company says it became a core supplier to multiple global AI server manufacturers (not named); 650V products achieved mass production and delivery to domestic core data center customers; Gen3 650V high-power products completed design-ins with key AI HVDC customers; dual-side cooling En-FCLGA packaged 100V products achieved design-ins with multiple leading AI 800VDC and 48VDC customers, citing 20% higher power density and a 1% efficiency advantage, and will achieve large-scale mass production in 2026; low-voltage devices below 30V for last-stage DC/DC conversion of GPU/CPU have commenced mass production and client sampling, raising switching frequency to the MHz level with a 30%-50% reduction in component volume and count and 2% to 4% higher overall efficiency; 1,200V high-power devices reached mass production in industry, renewable energy and AI servers with nearly 500,000 chips shipped.
quarterly_data.figure: AI and data center GaN revenue RMB63.19 million (+50.20%)

quarterly_data.signal: Other applications (FY2025): automotive-grade GaN chip deliveries rose 105% with sales revenue of RMB57.90 million; low-voltage GaN for autonomous driving and LiDAR RMB51.46 million (+31.21%), with in-vehicle LiDAR shipments exceeding 6 million chips; GaN chips for robotics reached mass production for the first time with sales of RMB1.26 million; consumer electronics revenue RMB568.1 million; emerging consumer scenarios (drones, electric bicycles, beauty appliances, e-cigarettes, televisions, audio) RMB56.47 million (+88.12%); household-appliance sales up 166.58%; industrial and energy storage RMB520.51 million (+137.93%); IC product revenue up 513%. It launched 87 new products, achieved 1,182 customer design-ins, added 39 new direct-sales customers and 3 new distributors, and delivered over 800 million GaN chips (more than 2 billion cumulative). In December 2025 the 6.6kW OBC system based on its 650V GaN, announced jointly with UAES and Changan Automobile, was implemented in mass-produced Changan Automobile models, and its bidirectional conduction devices completed AEC-Q102 automotive-grade certification, which the company says paves the way for mass production in 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: Industrial and energy storage RMB520.51 million (+137.93%); 1,182 customer design-ins

quarterly_data.signal: Capacity and manufacturing (FY2025 annual report): 8-inch GaN-on-Si wafer production capacity increased to 20,000 wafers per month by the end of 2025, with overall product yield above 95%; the high- and low-voltage 3.0 process platform is in large-scale mass production with chip yield per wafer up more than 30% vs the previous generation platform, and the 4.0 platform is in R&D. Capital expenditures were RMB210.6 million (RMB171.8 million in 2024), mainly capacity expansion equipment; capital commitments RMB159.1 million (RMB39.8 million) for capacity expansion equipment. Materials purchased include monocrystalline silicon substrates, photoresists, cleaning fluids, sputtering targets and special gases, increasingly from domestic suppliers; purchases from the top five suppliers were 72.28% of the total and from the single largest supplier 55.2% (not named).
quarterly_data.figure: Capacity 20,000 wafers per month; yield above 95%; capex RMB210.6 million

quarterly_data.signal: Customers (FY2025): GaN products were supplied to approximately 113 customers in China and overseas; the top five customers accounted for 48.35% of revenue and the single largest customer 31.71% (not named; Customer A RMB384,657 thousand vs RMB181,885 thousand in 2024); trade receivables from the five largest customers were 42% of the total and from the largest single customer 20.46%.
quarterly_data.figure: Top five customers 48.35% of revenue; largest 31.71%

quarterly_data.signal: 2026 outlook (FY2025 annual report): the company plans to further expand wafer production capacity upwards from 20,000 wafers per month while improving yield and reducing costs (the capacity program in the report's use-of-listing-proceeds table is to expand 8-inch GaN wafer capacity from 12,500 wafers per month as of June 30, 2024 to 70,000 wafers per month over the next five years); continue investing in the next-generation high- and low-voltage 4.0 technology platform and highly integrated solutions; promote scaled implementation of new products in data centers, automotive electronics, industry and energy storage; deepen strategic cooperation with major traditional power chip manufacturers abroad to drive mass production and shipments; and deepen technical cooperation in robots and computing-center servers. It says its 'senseGaN' products have design-ins for inbox applications and will scale up in 2026, and in-vehicle LED headlight and 48V DC-DC solutions developed with terminal customers will achieve mass production and vehicle integration in 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: Capacity plan: from 20,000 wafers per month; target 70,000 wafers per month over five years

quarterly_data.signal: Legal proceedings (FY2025 annual report): certain subsidiaries are respondents in the EPC California Case, the Infineon California Case and the Infineon Germany Case over claims of alleged infringement of intellectual property rights; the directors, having considered legal advice, are of the opinion that the group is more likely than not to prevail and that it is not probable it will need to make payments to the claimants, so no provision was made as of December 31, 2025.

contracts.signal: Innoscience FY2025 annual report: the company entered the 800V HVDC solution supply system of multiple domestic and international leading customers including NVIDIA, and through deep cooperation with NVIDIA became the only Chinese chip supplier in NVIDIA's 800V HVDC power architecture (company statement); it also says 800VDC power supply solutions built around its GaN devices account for more than half of the market (company claim).

Innoscience FY2025 annual report: the company established strategic cooperation with multiple top 10 international power semiconductor companies, including STMicroelectronics and onsemi, to jointly develop dozens of power and module solutions for high-density computing centers.
